name: AK23A - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Twin-Dial Display
highlights: Two Dials Split the Job — Particulates on the left, gases on the right, clock and climate down the centre. The two readings a room is most likely to fail on are separated rather than mixed into one column.
A Face With No Buttons on It — Controls sit out of sight, leaving a clean front panel. In a hotel room, a showroom or a reception area, the device reads as furniture rather than as instrumentation.
Smiley AQI Scale Across the Bottom — A six-step colour and expression scale under the readings, so a guest interprets the air without interpreting the numbers.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge over USB-C, 240 g, 105 × 90 × 50 mm.
32 Per Carton — The highest carton density among the large-screen desktop models — 500 × 261 × 302 mm outer, 14.05 kg gross.

specs.Readings: CO2, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO, TVOC, temperature, humidity, AQI
